title: Pastebin
prompt: Design a service like Pastebin where users paste text (up to a few MB), get a unique URL, and others can read it. Pastes can expire after a chosen time.
functionalReqs: Create a paste and get a unique link
Read a paste by its link
Pastes expire after a user-chosen duration (or never)
nonFunctionalReqs: Reads are fast and highly available
Paste content is durable until expiry

scale.storage: ~10 KB avg paste → ~10 GB/day, ~18 TB over 5 years
